pages.text: $(bold)Orbital Scan #0076$()$(br2)Refined Acheronite tools have $(bold)netherite-tier durability$(). Standard patterns, with Refined Acheronite and sticks.$(br2)$(italic)"Does the blade cauterize on contact?"$(br)"Send someone down to check."$()

pages.title: Acheronite Pickaxe
pages.text: Mines through frozen obsidian like butter. Very cold butter.

pages.title: Acheronite Blade
pages.text: Enemies shatter on impact. Morale also shatters. Mostly morale.$(br2)Recovered $(l:orsa_rd/soul_harvesting)Architect Souls$(/l) can be fused into the blade later, if your ethics have fully frozen over.

pages.title: Acheronite Axe
pages.text: For chopping dead trees. And anything else that looks at you wrong.

pages.title: Acheronite Shovel
pages.text: Digs through permafrost. A shovel that matches the terrain's hostility.
